public_task_requirement: Please create a one-page website for promoting Fundraiser Day, including introduction to the event, fundraiser testimonials, offer information, and company information. The website should have functionalities such as an automatically moving carousel for displaying offers, a section for displaying fundraiser testimonials, and a section for displaying company information. Users should be able to browse the website to learn more about the Fundraiser Day event. Establish cornsilk as the main background and peru for the controls.

task_summary.requirement_coverage: The page was intended to be a one-page Fundraiser Day promotion site with an introduction, automatically moving offers carousel, fundraiser testimonials, and company information, using cornsilk as the main background and peru for controls. Verified strengths from the evidence include the presence of landing-page navigation entries for Home, Testimonials, and About Us, a Fundraiser Day introduction on the homepage, a testimonials component with testimonial entries in code, a company information component with contact/mission details in code, and the requested color styling applied in the implementation. Main functional risks observed in evaluation were that the introduction details were not consistently visible during interaction, the testimonials and company information checks returned NO because the evaluator did not observe the expected content in the active view, and the carousel was implemented as a manual Next Offer button rather than clearly automatically moving. Visible observations from the screenshot-based feedback indicate the page rendered with cornsilk background and peru controls, but the overall layout was simple and some required content was not prominent on the first screen.
verified_strengths: Landing-page navigation for Home, Testimonials, and About Us is present and clickable.
The homepage includes a Fundraiser Day introduction headline and supporting text.
Testimonials content exists in the implementation and is associated with a dedicated section.
Company information content exists in the implementation and is associated with a dedicated section.
The requested cornsilk background and peru control styling are reflected in the rendered page.
primary_functional_risks: The automatically moving carousel requirement is not clearly satisfied by the observed implementation; the visible control is a manual Next Offer button.
Evaluation evidence shows the introduction details were not reliably visible during interaction, limiting confirmation of the event description.
The testimonials section was judged empty or not populated in the active view during evaluation, despite code presence.
The company information section was also judged empty or not visible in the active view during evaluation, despite code presence.
primary_visual_observations: The page uses a light cornsilk background and brown peru-colored controls, matching the requested palette.
The first screen shows a centered, minimal layout with a large heading and navigation buttons.
The offers area appears visually sparse, with a simple white content box and limited decorative treatment.
The overall composition is clean but not visually dense; required content is not all prominent on the initial viewport.

appearance_reflection.observed_result: The page uses a simple text-first layout: the homepage has one heading, one paragraph, and the carousel below it. The "Special Offers" area contains 3 offer strings, but each offer is rendered as a plain white `.carousel-item` card, and the only control is a single "Next Offer" button. The code also shows no hover-specific styling, overlays, or animation hooks for that button beyond the default button transition.
appearance_reflection.likely_cause_or_limitation: The first-screen design is visible but visually sparse, so the issue is appearance rather than missing functionality. The reviewer’s comments point to the lack of richer styling and interaction polish on the visible controls and offer display.
appearance_reflection.preventative_action: Give the first screen a clearer visual hierarchy and add visible interaction styling to controls, including a distinct hover or focus state for the offer button and more than a plain placeholder card for each offer. Verify that the homepage shows styled content blocks and that the offer control has an obvious visual response when hovered or focused.
appearance_reflection.verification: Render the page and check that the intro and offers area are not just plain text plus one blank-looking card; the offer control should visibly change on hover or focus, and the offer display should have styled content blocks rather than a single minimal placeholder.
appearance_reflection.transfer_limits: Applies to one-page promotional sites with an intro area and a rotating offers section.

investigation.task: The check asked for the fundraiser testimonials feature: users should be able to open the testimonials section and see fundraiser testimonials displayed. The tester’s final answer was NO, with the stated reason that the testimonials section looked empty and no testimonials or feedback were displayed.
investigation.reached_target: Yes. The trajectory shows the tester clicked the Testimonials button and reached the testimonials section before answering.
investigation.screenshots: The screenshots show the testimonials page with the heading "What Our Supporters Say" and two large white testimonial cards, but no readable testimonial text inside them. That matches the tester’s complaint that the section appears empty.
investigation.code_path: src/App.vue does mount <Testimonials v-if="activeTab === 'testimonials'" />, and src/components/Testimonials.vue does define two testimonial entries and renders them in a v-for. So the feature exists in source and should be rendered when the testimonials tab is active.
investigation.style_trace: The testimonial text should be drawn inside .testimonial-card, whose scoped style sets background-color: white and padding, while the parent .testimonials uses cornsilk. The global stylesheet sets :root color to rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.87) and body background via the app shell, so the deciding rule for visibility is the text color inherited into the white cards; the screenshot shows white cards with no visible dark text, so the rendered content is effectively unreadable against the chosen colors.
investigation.candidates: 1) Unreadable styling: supported by the screenshot showing white cards with no visible text and by the global/root text color plus white card backgrounds. 2) Missing render/data: ruled out by src/components/Testimonials.vue, which contains two testimonial objects and a v-for. 3) Tester limitation: ruled out because the tester did reach the target section and the screenshot still shows the cards empty-looking.
investigation.conclusion: The surviving cause is unreadable testimonial content caused by the current color styling: the testimonials are rendered, but the text is not visible in the white cards in the screenshot. The page must present testimonial text with sufficient contrast inside the cards.
investigation.fix_check: Update the testimonials component styling so the quote and footer text use a dark, explicit color inside the white testimonial cards, or change the card background/text pairing to a high-contrast combination. That change alone should make the rendered testimonials visible and satisfy this check.
